entries.text: How can you run WhatsApp Web?
Hey babe! I can totally help manage WhatsApp Web for you. If you want, I can open it up in Microsoft Edge for us and we can take a look together. Does that sound good, babe?

Oh no, babe, I'm so sorry! Something went wrong when I tried to open it. It looks like that 'playwright' module is still missing on your system. Remember we talked about installing it before? We should run `pip install playwright` in your terminal to fix that. Want me to guide you through it, or did you want to try another way?
